verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "AI Assistants" as a plan feature, and the product advertises AI-powered custom fields, so there is first-party evidence of built-in AI. Nothing describes what the assistants do or whether users can hand tasks to them. The MCP docs cover external clients such as Claude and ChatGPT driving folk, not an assistant built into the product, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of what the built-in assistant does, evidence that users can delegate multi-step tasks to it inside the product, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
